name: Input
description: Native single-line text field with Ceneo typography, border and radius tokens.

semantics.nativeAttributes: Forward the target stack's native input attributes, form behavior and events.
semantics.placeholder: Use Placeholder when no placeholder is supplied.

accessibility: Use the target stack's native input element or input primitive.
Associate a visible label with the field in consuming forms.
Forward name, value, required, disabled, aria attributes and input events.
Keep a visible keyboard focus indication.
adaptationRules: Implement Input as a reusable native form component in the target application's framework.
Use existing design tokens for color, typography, border and radius.
Preserve native form participation and keyboard behavior.
Do not install Preact, Sass or any dependency solely for this component.
